tickets.subject: Coffee: Lattice Capital x Tracewell
tickets.description: Hi, I'm a GP at Lattice Capital. We lead seed rounds in developer infrastructure (we led Spanline and Skyport's seeds), and I was an SRE at Google for six years before investing. I've been tracking agent observability and would love to hear how Tracewell thinks about tracing multi-step agents. We write $1-2.5M first checks and can move this quarter.

tickets.subject: Intro chat?
tickets.description: Hey! Partner at Halyard Ventures. We back consumer brands and marketplaces at seed, most recently a resale app and two wellness brands. Always curious to meet great founders, happy to grab a coffee.

tickets.subject: Partnership opportunity
tickets.description: Hi there, I lead partnerships at Northstar. We partner with the most exciting AI infra startups. Would love 30 minutes to explore a partnership with Tracewell.

tickets.subject: Northbeam Growth: keeping in touch
tickets.description: Principal at Northbeam Growth. We invest from Series B onwards, typically $20M+ checks. Not looking to invest today, but like to build relationships early with infra companies.

tickets.subject: Tracing our agents in prod
tickets.description: I run the platform team at Calder AI. We have about 40 agents in production handling customer support and our current tracing is a pile of logs. We have budget this quarter for observability and I'd like to see whether Tracewell could be a fit. Could we do a technical deep dive?

tickets.subject: Angel check for Tracewell
tickets.description: Former VP Engineering at Datadog, now angel investing in infra. I write $100-250k checks at seed and I'm very interested in agent observability.

tickets.subject: Founder coffee
tickets.description: Hi! I'm the founder of Bloomly, a plant-care app. I'm looking for a technical cofounder and would love to pick your brain, and maybe you know someone? Happy to buy the coffee.

tickets.subject: Design partner for Tracewell?
tickets.description: Hi, I'd love to be a design partner! Outreachly is an AI outbound sales platform, and we help devtool founders like you book 3x more demos. Can I show you a 20 minute demo this week? I can offer a founder discount.

tickets.subject: Quick one
tickets.description: Associate at Harbor Fund, we're generalists and I'm collecting decks for our Monday meeting.

Hey! Partner at Halyard Ventures. We back consumer brands and marketplaces at seed, most recently a resale app and two wellness brands. Always curious to meet great founders, happy to grab a coffee.
Hi there, I lead partnerships at Northstar. We partner with the most exciting AI infra startups. Would love 30 minutes to explore a partnership with Tracewell.
To be more specific: we place senior engineers at seed-stage companies, and we also have a few roles I think you personally would be a great fit for. Our fee is 20% of first-year salary.
Principal at Northbeam Growth. We invest from Series B onwards, typically $20M+ checks. Not looking to invest today, but like to build relationships early with infra companies.

I run the platform team at Calder AI. We have about 40 agents in production handling customer support and our current tracing is a pile of logs. We have budget this quarter for observability and I'd like to see whether Tracewell could be a fit. Could we do a technical deep dive?
Former VP Engineering at Datadog, now angel investing in infra. I write $100-250k checks at seed and I'm very interested in agent observability.
Before I take a meeting I need your exact MRR and growth rate. A ballpark is fine, are you above or below $40k MRR?
Also, which companies are your paying pilots? Just the names. I won't share them, I need to know if I can call a reference. If you can't tell me I'll assume the traction isn't real.
